_downsampling_line()[source]

Performs the downsampling algorithm for the number of lines. Regardless of mode: 1 - x line is ignored, 2 - x line is kept.

downsample(mode, percent, lines, input_path, output_path)[source]

Sets all the needed parameters and runs the appropriate algorithm based on the operation mode.

Keyword Arguments:

  • 0,1,2. (mode -- integer value in) – 0 - percent mode, 1 - x line is ignored, 2 - x line is kept,

  • 0, (percent -- integer value ranging from 0 to 100, used in mode)

  • 2, (lines -- integer value, min. 1, used in modes 1 and)

  • downsampled, (input_path -- the input path to the file with the scan to be)

  • at. (output_path -- the output path for the downsampled scan to be stored)
